name: Firebase Studio
summary: Web-based full-stack app development workspace with Gemini.
description: Firebase Studio is Google's entirely web-based workspace for building full-stack and mobile apps with Gemini assistance, Open VSX extensions, web previews and Android emulators. It integrates directly with Firebase App Hosting for deployment and monitoring. It is currently available at no cost during preview with 3 workspaces, and members of the Google Developer Program get up to 30 workspaces.

howToUse.title: Read the sunset notice
howToUse.description: The homepage says Firebase Studio sunsets on March 22, 2027, new workspaces can no longer be created, and existing code should move to Google AI Studio or Google Antigravity.

howToUse.title: Import a repository
howToUse.description: For work that is already in a workspace, the page says you can import a repository from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or your machine.

howToUse.title: Prototype in the workspace
howToUse.description: The same page says the App Prototyping agent can start an application from natural language, mockups, drawings, screenshots, or a template.

howToUse.title: Follow the docs
howToUse.description: Firebase Studio documentation is linked from the homepage.
